title: The Daily Biotech Pulse: Aeglea Stock Jumps On Inherited Metabolic Disease Data, Partial Hold Lifted On Gilead's 2 Blood Trials, Early Data From Novartis' KRAS Inhibitor And More
description:
Here's a roundup of top developments in the biotech space over the last 24 hours:
Stocks In Focus
Aeglea Shares Additional Phase 3 Data In Inherited Metabolic Disease
Aeglea BioTherapeutics Inc (NASDAQ: AGLE) shared additional data from the PEACE Phase 3 study in Arginase 1 Deficiency at the Society for Inherited Metabolic Disorders (SIMD) Annual Meeting.
In an analysis of individual patients, clinically significant differences between the pegzilarginase treated patients (n=17), and placebo (n=9) were observed in motor function.
Aeglea submitted an FDA marketing application for pegzilarginase in Arginase 1 Deficiency.
The stock was trading 31.7% higher at $3.20 in premarket trading.
Novartis Highlights Early Data From KRAS Inhibitor At AACR Meeting
Novartis AG (NYSE: NVS) shared clinical data for JDQ443, an investigational selective, covalent and orally bioavailable KRASG12C inhibitor.
Preliminary Phase 1b data showed that JDQ443 demonstrated anti-tumor activity, high systemic exposure at its recommended dose and a favorable safety profile in KRAS G12C-mutated solid tumors.
FDA Identifies Labeling Deficiency In Pfizer-Myovant's Myfembree Supplemental Application
The FDA identified deficiencies that preclude discussion of labeling and/or post-marketing requirements related to Myovant Sciences Inc (NYSE: MYOV) and Pfizer Inc's (NYSE: PFE) Myfembree for endometriosis-associated pain.
The agency did not provide additional detail. 
Myovant and Pfizer will continue to work with the FDA to determine the next steps with the application.

title: C4 Therapeutics Presents New Preclinical Data for CFT1946 Highlighting Superior Activity as a Single Agent to Clinically Approved BRAF Inhibitor Standard of Care Combinations at the American Association for Cancer Research Annual Meeting 2024
description: WATERTOWN, Mass., April  08, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- C4 Therapeutics, Inc. (C4T) (Nasdaq: CCCC), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing targeted protein degradation science, presented a poster today at the American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting 2024 highlighting new preclinical data for CFT1946 across multiple models of BRAF V600X mutant colorectal cancer (CRC) and non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), additional BRAF inhibitor (BRAFi)-resistant melanoma models, and an intracranial model of BRAF V600E metastatic melanoma.

title: C4 Therapeutics to Participate in the Stifel 2024 Targeted Oncology Forum
description: WATERTOWN, Mass., April  09, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- C4 Therapeutics, Inc. (C4T) (Nasdaq: CCCC), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing targeted protein degradation science, today announced that C4T management will participate in a fireside chat at the Stifel 2024 Targeted Oncology Forum taking place virtually from April 16 – April 17, 2024.

title: C4 Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
description: WATERTOWN, Mass., April  29, 2024  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- C4 Therapeutics, Inc. (C4T) (Nasdaq: CCCC), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing targeted protein degradation science, today announced that the independent directors serving on the Organization, Leadership and Compensation Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors approved the grant of non-qualified stock options to purchase 146,880 shares of the Company’s common stock to one new employee (the “Inducement Grant”), with the grant made on April 29, 2024 (the “Grant Date”). The Inducement Grant was granted as a material inducement to this individual entering into employment with C4T in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

title: C4 Therapeutics to Present Preliminary CFT1946 Monotherapy Phase 1 Clinical Data at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2024
description: C4 Therapeutics announced the release of preliminary data from its Phase 1 clinical trial of CFT1946, a novel BiDAC™ degrader, in mutant BRAF V600 solid tumors. The data will be presented at the ESMO Congress 2024, highlighting a favorable safety profile and early evidence of monotherapy anti-tumor activity.

title: C4 Therapeutics Presents Monotherapy Data Demonstrating Proof of Mechanism and Early Evidence of Proof of Concept From Ongoing CFT1946 Phase 1 Trial in BRAF V600 Mutant Solid Tumors at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2024
description: C4 Therapeutics presented initial clinical data from the ongoing Phase 1 trial of CFT1946, a degrader of BRAF V600 mutations in solid tumors. The data showed CFT1946 is well-tolerated, achieves dose-dependent pharmacokinetic exposure, and demonstrates early evidence of anti-tumor activity in patients who have progressed on BRAF inhibitor therapies.

title: C4 Therapeutics Appoints Accomplished Oncology Executive Steve Hoerter to Board of Directors
description: C4 Therapeutics, Inc. (C4T) has appointed Steve Hoerter, a veteran with over three decades of experience in oncology commercialization, to its Board of Directors. Hoerter's expertise in strategically advancing oncology programs is expected to guide C4T's plans to become a fully integrated biotechnology company.

title: C4 Therapeutics Presents Cemsidomide Phase 1 Data at the American Society for Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting that Demonstrated Potential to Become Best-in-Class IKZF1/3 Degrader
description: C4 Therapeutics presented positive Phase 1 data for its IKZF1/3 degrader cemsidomide in multiple myeloma and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, demonstrating anti-tumor activity and a well-tolerated safety profile. The company plans to advance cemsidomide into further clinical development.
